teaser.slogan: Dive into the world of Logic Circuits for free!
teaser.description:
Design your own circuits with ease, from basic gates to intricate sequential circuits, using our platform. You can plot create circuits, documentation and learning materials. Whether you're a hobbyist or an enterprise user, our platform has got you covered. It's designed to be intuitive and user-friendly, so you can focus on bringing your ideas to life. Ready to get started?

Join us today and experience the power of circuit design at your fingertips!

demo.slogan: Building your very first circuit it's easy as 1..2..3
demo.description1: Design circuits quickly and easily with a modern and intuitive user interface with drag-and-drop, copy/paste, zoom and more.
demo.description2: With Electra.Academy, you can edit and run your digital circuit simulation designs online within your browser and trigger any physical device.

slidedeck1.slogan: Visual connect, control, and learn digital electronics
slidedeck1.description:
With Electra Academy you can edit and run your simulation designs and trigger any physical device

When you build an arbitrary circuit, Electra.Academy shows you how it works, even if you have just invented a new design. This is made possible by a custom-built circuit simulation engine under the hood.

slidedeck2.slogan: Designed to be very easy to use in classes
slidedeck2.description:
Electra Academy has been designed to be very easy to use in classes. The platform has features to assist teachers in class and assignments.
It is easy to write learning materials or lessons in the build in editor.

slidedeck3.description: Of course an own designer is also part of the total package. So you have the possibility to draw your own shapes for the simulator and bring it to life with JS.

slidedeck4.slogan: Welcome in the Universe of Electra Academy

footer.tagline: Electra.Academy is a free platform for digital circuit design. Build, simulate and understand - in the browser, nothing to install. Free for schools.

section01.body: Cookies are small text files a website stores in your browser. A site may also use your browser's local storage (localStorage). We describe both here together, because both store data on your device.

section02.body:
We set only our own, strictly necessary cookies. No third-party cookies are set, and there is no advertising and no tracking.

NameTypePurposeLifetimeProvider
connect.sidCookieKeeps your session together and remembers whether you are signed in.24 hoursElectra.Academy
i18nextLngLocal storageRemembers the language you chose (German or English).until you clear itElectra.Academy

section03.body: The entries above are strictly necessary for the site to work and to remember your language and your sign-in. Strictly necessary cookies do not require consent under section 25(2) TDDDG. Should we ever use non-essential cookies - for statistics or advertising, say - we will ask for your consent first and update this page.

section04.header: How to delete or block cookies
section04.body: You can view, delete or block cookies and local storage at any time in your browser settings. If you block the strictly necessary entries, sign-in and remembering your language may stop working.
